findings.body: This renders version 1 with the current configured contact address on every request. Changing that address changes the text served for the same published version without creating a new version or requiring existing members to accept the changed text. Saving an address with each consent can reconstruct what a member accepted, but it does not retain one exact published text for the version. Publish a new version when the rendered text changes, or store the rendered text with the version.
findings.title: Not done: retain each published notice version's exact text
